name: The Cape
insider_take: Where desert meets ocean in pure sophistication - The Cape delivers Cabo's most coveted clifftop experience.
whats_special: Perched dramatically on the cliffs of Cabo's Hotel Corridor, The Cape features stunning infinity pools that appear to spill directly into the Sea of Cortez. The property's award-winning Manta restaurant offers inventive Japanese cuisine with panoramic ocean views, while the rooftop bar provides unobstructed sunset vistas over the famous Arch of Cabo San Lucas.
pro_tip: Book a clifftop suite for direct access to the hotel's exclusive beach club via a private funicular - it's one of the few swimmable beaches in the area with calm, protected waters.
dont_miss: The signature "floating" breakfast served on a tray in your private plunge pool, and the hotel's complimentary yacht shuttle service to downtown Cabo Marina. Time your visit during gray whale migration season (December-April) for incredible whale watching right from your balcony.
pros: Dramatic clifftop location with stunning Pacific Ocean views
Contemporary design and sophisticated modern amenities
Premium beachfront access to Monuments Beach
Exclusive Hyatt Privé program benefits and privileges
